title: JSON-LD Modeler project
description: An ldm.project.yaml file. Declares which models belong together, where published versions are written, and which hosts the published tree must serve from.

project.description: The version of the project format this file is written against.

name.description: What this project is called. Appears in the generated-file header of every artifact it publishes.

models.description: A map from model name to the model file's path, relative to this file. A model belongs to at most one project.

baseUrl.description: The absolute IRI the published tree is served from. A model's `uses` entry under this IRI resolves from the tree rather than the vendor directory, and no network request is made for it.

published.description: The directory published versions are written into, relative to this file. Committed alongside the models.

versions.description: The directory immutable versions are stored in, relative to this file.

hosts.description: The hosts the published tree must be valid for. Publishing fails if a name produces a path any of them cannot serve.

note.description: Documentation for this project. Carried by the project file; a published tree cannot hold it.

modelName.description: How a command names this model. Not the file name, and not the model's namespace prefix.

hostName.description: A host adapter this build knows. Each declares the path constraints and side files that host requires.
